title: SQS not-found, awsQueryCompatible, header absent (Overcast today)
why: The same error as sqs-query-compatible-header, from an emulator that does not send x-amzn-query-error yet (#1810). The pair is what makes the header a surface rather than a decoration: the clause naming only the Query code matches with the header and does not match without it, and no interpreter may paper over the difference by matching on containment.

body.message: The specified queue does not exist.
